en.tagline: Build and edit PPTX decks with templates and visual QA
en.summary: This skill helps an agent create, inspect, and edit Microsoft PowerPoint .pptx decks. It covers layouts, placeholders, speaker notes, comments, charts, and template fidelity. It also sets a QA pass so the deck renders cleanly after edits.
problem: Editing a PowerPoint deck is easy to get wrong. Content can land in the wrong placeholder. Template sample text can stay in the slides. Master and layout settings can override a local edit. Charts can break when category counts and series lengths do not match.

With this skill, the agent inventories the deck and template before changing content. It matches content to the real placeholders and keeps the template's theme. It then runs content QA and visual QA as separate passes, with at least one fix-and-verify cycle.
fit: Editing an existing deck that was built from a template
Rebuilding slides while keeping the original theme, layouts, and aspect ratio
Decks with charts, speaker notes, or comments that must still work after edits
unfit: Tasks where the output is not a .pptx file, such as a written document
Visual direction work with no deck to build or edit
steps: Choose the workflow first: read, edit, rebuild from a template, or create from scratch.
Inventory the deck by counting layouts, placeholders, notes, comments, media, and the theme fonts and colors.
Count the content pieces and pick a layout whose real placeholders match them.
Keep the template's theme, master, fonts, spacing, and aspect ratio instead of adding a new style.
Run content QA to find leftover placeholder text, sample labels, and chart or note problems.
Render the slides for visual QA, fix the issues, and re-check the affected slides.

zh.tagline: 创建和编辑PPTX，支持模板与视觉检查
zh.summary: 该技能帮助代理创建、检查和编辑 Microsoft PowerPoint 的 .pptx 演示文稿。内容涵盖版式、占位符、演讲者备注、批注、图表和模板一致性。编辑后，它还会做质量检查，确保演示文稿渲染正常。
problem: 编辑 PowerPoint 演示文稿很容易出错。内容可能落到错误的占位符中。模板的示例文字可能残留在幻灯片里。母版或版式设置可能覆盖局部修改。类别数量和数据系列长度不一致时，图表也会出错。
使用该技能后，代理会先清点演示文稿和模板，再修改内容。它会把内容对应到实际的占位符，并保留模板的主题。随后，内容检查和视觉检查分开进行，并且至少完成一轮修复与复核。
fit: 编辑由模板制作的现有演示文稿
在保留原有主题、版式和宽高比的前提下重做幻灯片
包含图表、演讲者备注或批注、且编辑后必须正常工作的演示文稿
unfit: 输出物不是 .pptx 文件的任务，例如书面文档
没有演示文稿可制作或编辑的视觉设计方向工作
steps: 先选择工作方式：阅读、编辑、基于模板重做，或从零创建。
清点演示文稿，统计版式、占位符、备注、批注、媒体，以及主题字体和颜色。
统计内容的实际数量，选择占位符数量与之匹配的版式。
保留模板的主题、母版、字体、间距和宽高比，不另起一套风格。
进行内容检查，查找残留的占位符文字、示例标签以及图表或备注问题。
渲染幻灯片做视觉检查，修复问题，并重新检查受影响的幻灯片。
